narrative_explanation.full_narrative:
The hybrid screening model categorized this image as CANCER with an estimated model confidence of 86.5% (model cancer probability: 86.5%).

Both architectural branches contributed in a balanced manner to the final classification: the Vision Transformer visual branch provided 59.3% of the attribution, while the GATv2 relational graph branch provided 40.7%.

The model's output was influenced more strongly by highlighted image regions in the Superior-Right (Top Right) and Inferior-Right (Bottom Right). These visual patches exhibited elevated self-attention in the transformer encoder blocks, while the graph branch assigned greater contribution to topological pathways connecting these areas with surrounding oral tissue.

Explanation stability was verified deterministically; repeated evaluations on identical inputs yielded zero numerical deviation.
